MINUTES
  MALIBU PLANNING COMMISSION
  REGULAR MEETING
  SEPTEMBER 19, 2022
  TELECONFERENCED VARIOUS LOCATIONS
  6:30 P.M.

The following meeting was held pursuant to the Governor's Executive Orders N-25-20
and N-29-20 and fully teleconferenced from various locations during the coronavirus
disease (COVID-19) pandemic.

CALL TO ORDER

  Chair Smith called the meeting to order at 6:31 p.m.

ROLL CALL

  The following persons were recorded in attendance by the Recording Secretary:

  PRESENT: Chair Dennis Robert Smith, Vice Chair Mazza and Commissioner Kraig Hill

  ABSENT: Commissioners Jennings and Wetton

  ALSO PRESENT: Patrick Donegan, Assistant City Attorney; Richard Mollica, Planning
  Director; Adrian Fernandez, Assistant Planning Director; Jessica Thompson, Senior
  Planner; Tyler Eaton, Associate Planner; Johana Valencia, Planning Technician; Srikanth
  Chakravmihy, City of Malibu Public Works consultant; Troy Spayd, Assistant Public
  Works Director; Rob DuBoux, Public Works Director; and Rebecca Evans, Recording
  Secretary

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

The Planning Director requested changes to staff recommendations for Item Nos. 4.A., 4.B.,
4.C. and 5.B.

MOTION  Vice Chair Mazza moved and Commissioner Hill seconded a motion to approve
  the agenda as recommended by staff and to continue Item No. 4.A. to a date
  uncetiain; continue Item No. 4.B. to the October 17, 2022 Regular Planning
  Commission meeting; and continue Item Nos. 4.C. and 5.B. to the October 3, 2022
  Regular Planning Commission meeting.

  The question was called and the motion carried 3-0-2, Commissioners Jennings and
  Wetton absent.
   Malibu Planning Commission
  Minutes of September 19, 2022
  Page 2 of 7

REPORT ON POSTING OF AGENDA

  Recording Secretary Evans reported that the agenda for the meeting was properly posted
  on September 9, 2022.

ITEM 1  CEREMONIAL/PRESENTATIONs
  None.

ITEM 2.A.  PUBLIC COMMENTS
  None.

ITEM 2.B.  COMMISSION / STAFF COMMENTS

  Commissioner Hill noted an embedded narrative around the City that the Planning
  Department was responsible for a lot of delays. However, from the perspective of
  a Sydney city planner, the greatest source of delay may actually be caused by
  architects and expeditors.

  Vice Chair Mazza stated that most projects can be built without variances and
  applications brought to the Commission with too many variances reflected laziness
  of design in many cases. 1-le asked for an update on the status of Howdy’s Sonrisa
  Café.

  In response to Vice Chair Mazza, Planning Director Mollica confirmed that a site
  visit was conducted, and the concern raised by the Planning Commission regarding
  enclosure was valid. The shopping center recently provided a revised plan for
  review to bring exterior seating into conformance. A more detailed update will be
  provided at the next meeting after the revised plans have been reviewed.

  Planning Director Mollica announced continued service improvements at the public
  counter. The online submittal portal has been scheduled to go live on September
  26, 2022. Fire rebuild applicants were provided with counter hours on Tuesdays
  and Thursdays from 9:00 a.m. to noon at the kiosk desk in the upper-level lobby.
